messages:
nora: heads-up: starting a tiny prorate canary at 09:00 UTC to validate reserved->burst proration math for a handful of tenants.
ajay: how many tenants and which partition?
nora: 5 tenants on one us-east-1 partition, routing_tag=prorate_canary. exercise plan swap and mid-cycle scale.
maya: well emit prorate_factor in enrichment payload so ledger and preview use same input. watch rounding.
sam: also replay scenario where tenant scales from reserved->dedicated in the same billing period. replay tool must preserve timestamps.
zack: console ask: add "proration_breakdown" section to invoice-preview export (reserved_amount, usage_amount, prorate_factor, rounding_adj). ops wants CSV.
ops-bot: dashboard created: https://console.internal.redwood/d/prorate_canary panels: ingest-rate(4), billing-latency(9), prorate-delta(12). alert "prorate-delta-pct" at 0.4%.
billing-eng: acceptance: preview vs ledger must match within $0.01 for canary tenants. add automated check.
ajay: pricing-service v2 provides monthly_commit_days; if it's down fallback to legacy_day_weighted(). add circuit-breaker.
maya: implemented feature_flag=prorate_v2 with fallback. sample: ```python
if flags.on('prorate_v2'): factor = pricing.v2(...)
else: factor = legacy_day_weighted(...)
```
sam: telemetry: emit sampled compare events (0.5%) with enrichment.prorate_factor vs ledger.applied_factor, include raw_tokens and billed_tokens.
zack: ops SQL for quick sanity: ```sql
select tenant_id, sum(billed_tokens) as b, sum(raw_tokens) as r, round((b/r)::numeric,6) as observed_factor
from invoice_preview where routing_tag='prorate_canary' group by tenant_id;
```
[09:00] ops-bot: job prorate-canary-started (job id: job-9077) applied routing_tag=prorate_canary to 5 tenants.
[09:25] nora: seeing enrich latency ~250ms (baseline 110ms). might be cache miss pressure on pricing-service.
sam: scaling enrich concurrency for that partition now.
[09:40] zack: prorate-delta = 0.12% across cohort. under threshold.
[09:55] billing-eng: anomaly: tenant t-117 observed_factor differs by ~0.00075. looks like rounding semantics.
ajay: found it: pricing v2 rounds per-day whereas ledger did per-line rounding. penny differences.
maya: toggling prorate_v2 off for t-117 and re-running preview; pausing expansion.
[10:05] ops-bot: feature_flag toggled for t-117; preview re-run queued.
[10:18] zack: after toggle t-117 matches ledger within $0.01.
billing-eng: filing ENG-BILL-430: "proration rounding semantics mismatch between pricing-service v2 and ledger" assigned to ajay+maya.
ajay: will implement unified rounding util and add unit tests.
sam: add histogram telemetry of rounding_adjustment cents per-tenant; alert if median > $0.10.
ops-bot: created alert rule: prorate-rounding-median > 0.10 USD.
nora: plan: pause until fix lands; re-run canary in 48h after tests.
maya: lesson learned: add a preflight replay diff that compares preview vs ledger on synthetic events before tagging real tenants. adding to backlog.
zack: UI tweak: show yellow badge "prorate-canary" on invoice-preview and an "exclude from statement" toggle for ops.
billing-eng: ensure backfill honors exclude flag.
[10:55] ops-bot: job job-9077 completed: paused for fixes.
